NM1_any_block_suppresses._note: The pre-#3910 shape: any block of a daily Layout steps the time table aside.
NM1_any_block_suppresses.to: const dailyTasksBlockActive = claimedDailyPartitions.has("tasks") || (layoutActive && layout !== null && layout.blocks.length > 0);

UM1_provider_not_forwarded._note: U5 and U6 redden by mechanism: it drives the real ExoLayoutRenderer through two page renders, so the provider, the begun page and its carried generation all reach the painted block.

UM4_generation_not_carried._note: U5 and U6 redden by mechanism: it drives the real ExoLayoutRenderer through two page renders, so the provider, the begun page and its carried generation all reach the painted block.

UM5_page_begun_after_first_await._note: Review M1: the page is begun only after the button groups build — a slower first render takes the generation from a refresh() that started later, the visible block stays on loading and the query runs twice. The build inside the mutant is caught so a build failure does not escape render() (review round 2, L4: otherwise the mutant changes a second property).

UM6_page_begun_after_lazy_loader._note: Review round 2, M1: in production the lazy asset-graph loader is wired, so its await is the first one; the page begun after it loses the generation to a refresh() the same way.
